headline: This law moves the post office named after Sergeant First Class Alwyn Crendall Cashe to a new street address in Oviedo, Florida.
what_it_does: It amends an earlier law that named a U.S. Postal Service facility in Oviedo, Florida, after Sergeant First Class Alwyn Crendall Cashe. The earlier law listed the facility at 567 East Franklin Street, and this law changes that address to 83 Geneva Drive. The naming itself stays the same; only the listed address changes.
